### 2) Add these **new styles** to your `StyleSheet.create({...})`

Put them anywhere inside the `styles` object:

```ts
  // keep content above the sticky footer

  },

```

(These reference only properties you already have; no new theme keys.)

---

### 3) Tiny fix: replace `backgroundColor: colors.transparent`
Everywhere you used `colors.transparent`, switch to plain `'transparent'`. The theme has no `transparent` key, so `colors.transparent` is `undefined`.

---

### Why this solves it

- **Parsing/runtime error gone:** the stray JSX is removed, so Expo Go won’t crash at load.  
- **Buttons stacked at bottom:** `bottomStackButtons` is absolutely positioned; the ScrollView gets extra bottom padding so content never hides behind the footer.  
- **Visual flow:** the main CTA (“craft your moment”) is now the first button in the sticky footer; secondary actions (“Chemical Relationships”, “Patterns”) follow in a tidy vertical stack.

If you want the footer to be slightly elevated, add a subtle shadow:

```ts
bottomStackButtons: {
  // ...existing
  shadowColor: '#000',
  shadowOpacity: 0.08,
  shadowRadius: 12,
  shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: -2 },
  elevation: 6,
}
```

```tsx
const getCurrentContainer = (): ContainerId => {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour >= 0 && hour < 6) return 'late';
  if (hour >= 6 && hour < 12) return 'morning';
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 18) return 'afternoon';
  return 'evening';
};

    ]).start();

const getPatternInsights = () => {
    const today = new Date();
    const weekAgo = new Date(today.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const weekCompletions = completions.filter(c => new Date(c.date) >= weekAgo);

const itemStats: { [key: string]: { did: number; total: number; tags: ResonanceTag[] } } = {};

items.forEach(item => {
      const itemCompletions = weekCompletions.filter(c => c.item_id === item.id);
      const didCount = itemCompletions.filter(c => c.outcome === 'did').length;
      const allTags = itemCompletions.flatMap(c => c.resonance_tags || []);

itemStats[item.id] = { did: didCount, total: itemCompletions.length, tags: allTags };
    });

const resonating = items.filter(item => itemStats[item.id]?.did >= 4).map(item => ({ item, count: itemStats[item.id].did }));
    const notSticking = items
      .filter(item => itemStats[item.id]?.total >= 3 && itemStats[item.id]?.did <= 1)
      .map(item => ({ item, count: itemStats[item.id].did }));

return { resonating, notSticking, weekCompletions };
  };

<TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.7} onPress={() => handleOutcomeSelect('forgot')} style={[styles.outcomeButtonSmall, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}>

<View style={styles.outcomeRow}>

---

<Text style={[styles.outcomeButtonTextSmall, { color: colors.text }]}>couldn't</Text>

<TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.7} onPress={() => handleOutcomeSelect('not_relevant')} style={[styles.outcomeButtonSmall, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.dim }]}>

{completion && (

---

<TouchableOpacity onPress={() => deleteAllyLog(log.id)}>

                />

<Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginTop: 16, marginBottom: 8 }]}>Why this moment?</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.logInput, styles.logInputMulti, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  placeholder="tension, focus needed, celebration..."
                  placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                  value={modalWhy}
                  onChangeText={setModalWhy}
                  multiline
                />

<Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginTop: 16, marginBottom: 8 }]}>How do you feel?</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.logInput, styles.logInputMulti, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  placeholder="what shifted, what you notice..."
                  placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                  value={modalFeeling}
                  onChangeText={setModalFeeling}
                  multiline
                />

<View style={styles.modalButtons}>
                  <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleLogInteraction} style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                    <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.bg }]}>Save</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    onPress={() => {
                      setShowInteractionModal(false);
                      setModalRoute('oral');
                      setModalDosage('');
                      setModalWhy('');
                      setModalFeeling('');
                    }}
                    style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>Cancel</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              </ScrollView>
            </View>
          </View>
        </Modal>
      </View>
    );
  }

return null;
}
```

type ContainerId = 'late' | 'morning' | 'afternoon' | 'evening';
type ItemType = 'grounding' | 'custom' | 'appointment';

type ResonanceTag = 'water' | 'light' | 'movement' | 'sound' | 'novelty' | 'social';
type MissReason = 'forgot' | 'overwhelm' | 'transport' | 'conflict' | 'logistics' | 'cost' | 'not_ready';
type PressureMode = 'normal' | 'softened';

// ── Substance Ally System (Living Pharmacopoeia)
type SubstanceAlly = 
  | 'benzodiazepine'
  | 'stimulant'
  | 'cannabis'
  | 'opioid'
  | 'entheogen'
  | 'alcohol'
  | 'nootropic';

type SubstanceRoute = 'oral' | 'smoked' | 'vaped' | 'sublingual' | 'nasal' | 'topical' | 'other';
type SubstanceIntention = 'relief' | 'focus' | 'connection' | 'exploration' | 'rest' | 'celebration' | 'medicine';
type SubstanceRelation = 'lighter' | 'same' | 'spikier' | 'teachings' | 'warnings';

interface AllyArchetype {
  name: string;
  face: string; // The ally's name/title
  function: string; // What it offers
  shadow: string; // What it can become
  invocation: string; // Prayer/intention to hold
}

interface SubstanceLog {
  id: string;
  timestamp: string; // Full ISO datetime
  day_key: string; // YYYY-MM-DD for grouping
  ally: SubstanceAlly;
  specific_name?: string; // e.g., "lorazepam", "coffee", "psilocybin"
  amount?: string;
  route?: SubstanceRoute;
  intention?: SubstanceIntention;

// Pre-contact
  state_before?: string; // Free text: nervous system state
  craving_intensity?: number; // 0-10

// Post-contact
  felt_effect?: SubstanceRelation;
  state_after?: string; // What shifted
  gratitude?: string; // What you learned/received
  caution?: string; // Shadow aspects noticed

// Context
  with_others?: boolean;
  setting?: string; // Where: home, social, nature, etc.
}

interface ContainerItem {
  id: string;
  type: ItemType;
  title: string;
  body_cue?: string;
  micro_version?: string;
  container: ContainerId;

// If appointment
  time?: string;
  date?: string;
  warmup_enabled?: boolean;
  warmup_task?: string;
  buffer_minutes?: number;
}

interface Completion {
  item_id: string;
  container: ContainerId;
  date: string;
  outcome: Outcome;
  afterfeel?: Afterfeel;
  resonance_tags?: ResonanceTag[];
  miss_reason?: MissReason;
}

interface TimeContainer {
  id: ContainerId;

  pressure_mode: PressureMode;
}

  bg: string;
  card: string;

  text: string;
  dim: string;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// UTILITY: GET CURRENT CONTAINER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const getCurrentContainer = (): ContainerId => {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour >= 0 && hour < 6) return 'late';
  if (hour >= 6 && hour < 12) return 'morning';
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 18) return 'afternoon';
  return 'evening';
};

  };

    Animated.sequence([

        toValue: amplitude,
        duration: 200,

      }),

        toValue: 1,
        duration: 200,
        useNativeDriver: true
      })
    ]).start();
  };

    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    return completions.find(c => c.item_id === itemId && c.date === today);
  };

    if (item && item.type !== 'grounding') {
      Alert.alert(

        [

const handleOutcomeSelect = (outcome: Outcome) => {
    if (!activeItem) return;

// Trigger exhale animation
    triggerExhaleAnimation();

if (outcome === 'did') {
      setSelectedOutcome(outcome);
      // Show shift modal if user hasn't disabled it
      if (shiftYesCount < 3) {
        setShowShiftModal(true);
      } else {
        // Evolved to micro-affirmation
        setCompletionPhrase('small current moved');
        setTimeout(() => {
          setTempAfterfeel(null);
          setTempTags([]);
          setCurrentScreen('outcome');
          setCompletionPhrase('');
        }, 1500);
      }
    } else {
      // For non-did outcomes, save directly
      const completion: Completion = {
        item_id: activeItem.id,
        container: activeItem.container,
        date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        outcome
      };
      setCompletions([...completions, completion]);
      setCompletionPhrase(getCompletionPhrase());

// Show phrase briefly then return
      setTimeout(() => {
        setActiveItem(null);
        setCurrentScreen('containers');
        setCompletionPhrase('');
      }, 1200);
    }
  };

  };

  setCompletionPhrase(getCompletionPhrase());

setTimeout(() => {
    setActiveItem(null);

    setCompletionPhrase('');
  }, 1200);
};

  // PATTERN INSIGHTS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const getPatternInsights = () => {
    const today = new Date();
    const weekAgo = new Date(today.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const weekCompletions = completions.filter(c => new Date(c.date) >= weekAgo);

// Calculate completion rates per item
    const itemStats: { [key: string]: { did: number; total: number; tags: ResonanceTag[] } } = {};

items.forEach(item => {
      const itemCompletions = weekCompletions.filter(c => c.item_id === item.id);
      const didCount = itemCompletions.filter(c => c.outcome === 'did').length;
      const allTags = itemCompletions.flatMap(c => c.resonance_tags || []);

itemStats[item.id] = {
        did: didCount,
        total: itemCompletions.length,
        tags: allTags
      };
    });

// Find resonating tasks (high completion)
    const resonating = items
      .filter(item => itemStats[item.id]?.did >= 4)
      .map(item => ({ item, count: itemStats[item.id].did }));

// Find not-sticking tasks (low completion)
    const notSticking = items
      .filter(item => itemStats[item.id]?.total >= 3 && itemStats[item.id]?.did <= 1)
      .map(item => ({ item, count: itemStats[item.id].did }));

return { resonating, notSticking, weekCompletions };
  };

```tsx
const getPatternInsights = () => {

    const weekCompletions = completions.filter(c => new Date(c.date) >= weekAgo);
    const itemStats: { [key: string]: { did: number; total: number; tags: ResonanceTag[] } } = {};
    items.forEach(item => {
      const ic = weekCompletions.filter(c => c.item_id === item.id);
      const didCount = ic.filter(c => c.outcome === 'did').length;
      const allTags = ic.flatMap(c => c.resonance_tags || []);
      itemStats[item.id] = { did: didCount, total: ic.length, tags: allTags };
    });
    const resonating = items.filter(i => itemStats[i.id]?.did >= 4).map(i => ({ item: i, count: itemStats[i.id].did }));
    const notSticking = items.filter(i => itemStats[i.id]?.total >= 3 && itemStats[i.id]?.did <= 1).map(i => ({ item: i, count: itemStats[i.id].did }));
    return { resonating, notSticking, weekCompletions };
  };

{/* Shift modal (also here) */}
        <Modal visible={showShiftModal} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={() => setShowShiftModal(false)}>
          <View style={styles.shiftModalOverlay}>
            <View style={[styles.shiftModalContent, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.shiftModalText, { color: colors.text }]}>feel that shift?</Text>
              <View style={styles.shiftModalButtons}>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => handleShiftResponse(true)} style={[styles.shiftModalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.shiftModalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>yes</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => handleShiftResponse(false)}
                  style={[styles.shiftModalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent, borderWidth: 1 }]}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.shiftModalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>not yet</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleShiftSkipAlways}>
                <Text style={[styles.shiftModalSkip, { color: colors.dim }]}>skip always</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </Modal>
      </View>
    );
  }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER: OUTCOME
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (currentScreen === 'outcome') {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
          <Text style={[styles.outcomeTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>How did it feel?</Text>

<View style={styles.afterfeelButtons}>
            {(['lighter', 'same', 'spikier'] as Afterfeel[]).map(feel => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={feel}
                onPress={() => setTempAfterfeel(feel)}
                style={[styles.afterfeelButton, { backgroundColor: tempAfterfeel === feel ? colors.accent : colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.afterfeelText, { color: colors.text }]}>{feel}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>

<Text style={[styles.tagsPrompt, { color: colors.dim }]}>What helped? (pick up to 2, or skip)</Text>

<View style={styles.tagsContainer}>
            {(['water', 'light', 'movement', 'sound', 'novelty', 'social'] as ResonanceTag[]).map(tag => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={tag}
                onPress={() => {
                  if (tempTags.includes(tag)) setTempTags(tempTags.filter(t => t !== tag));
                  else if (tempTags.length < 2) setTempTags([...tempTags, tag]);
                }}
                style={[styles.tagChip, { backgroundColor: tempTags.includes(tag) ? colors.accent : colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.tagText, { color: colors.text }]}>{tag}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>

<TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => { if (tempAfterfeel) handleAfterfeelSelect(tempAfterfeel, tempTags); }}
            style={[styles.doneButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent, opacity: tempAfterfeel ? 1 : 0.5 }]}
            disabled={!tempAfterfeel}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.doneButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>done</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

<TouchableOpacity onPress={() => handleAfterfeelSelect('same', [])}>
            <Text style={[styles.skipText, { color: colors.dim }]}>skip</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    );
  }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER: PATTERNS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (currentScreen === 'patterns') {
    const { resonating, notSticking } = getPatternInsights();
    return (
      <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setCurrentScreen('containers')} style={styles.backButton}>
            <Text style={[styles.backText, { color: colors.dim }]}>← back</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

<Text style={[styles.patternsTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>This Week's Patterns</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.patternsSubtitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>no judgment, just data</Text>

<View style={styles.patternSection}>
            <Text style={[styles.patternSectionTitle, { color: colors.accent }]}>OVERALL PATTERNS</Text>

{!showPatternInput ? (
              <TouchableOpacity
                onPress={() => setShowPatternInput(true)}
                style={[styles.addButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.addButtonText, { color: colors.accent }]}>+ notice a pattern</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ) : (
              <View style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.logInput, styles.logInputMulti, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  placeholder="what are you noticing? energy, timing, triggers, rhythms..."
                  placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                  value={newPatternNote}
                  onChangeText={setNewPatternNote}
                  multiline
                  autoFocus
                />
                <View style={styles.modalButtons}>
                  <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSavePatternNote} style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                    <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.bg }]}>Save</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    onPress={() => { setShowPatternInput(false); setNewPatternNote(''); }}
                    style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>Cancel</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              </View>
            )}

{patternNotes.map(note => (
              <View key={note.id} style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
                <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim, marginBottom: 8 }]}>
                  {new Date(note.date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}
                </Text>
                <Text style={[styles.patternItemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{note.note}</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => deletePatternNote(note.id)}>
                  <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim, marginTop: 8 }]}>(tap to delete)</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>

{resonating.length > 0 && (
            <View style={styles.patternSection}>
              <Text style={[styles.patternSectionTitle, { color: colors.accent }]}>WHAT'S WORKING</Text>
              {resonating.map(({ item, count }) => (
                <View key={item.id} style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.patternItemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{item.title}</Text>
                  <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim }]}>{count}/7 days</Text>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          )}

{notSticking.length > 0 && (
            <View style={styles.patternSection}>
              <Text style={[styles.patternSectionTitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>NOT STICKING</Text>
              {notSticking.map(({ item, count }) => (
                <View key={item.id} style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.patternItemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{item.title}</Text>
                  <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim }]}>{count}/7 days — maybe too much friction?</Text>
                </View>

---

))}
            </View>
          )}

{resonating.length === 0 && notSticking.length === 0 && (
            <View style={[styles.emptyState, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.emptyText, { color: colors.dim }]}>Not enough data yet. Check back after a few days of tracking.</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    );
  }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER: CHEMICALS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (currentScreen === 'chemicals') {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setCurrentScreen('containers')} style={styles.backButton}>
            <Text style={[styles.backText, { color: colors.dim }]}>← back</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

<Text style={[styles.patternsTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>Chemical Relationships</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.patternsSubtitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>your living pharmacopeia</Text>

{!showAddSubstance ? (
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setShowAddSubstance(true)} style={[styles.addButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.addButtonText, { color: colors.accent }]}>+ add substance</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ) : (
            <View style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card, marginBottom: 24 }]}>
              <TextInput
                style={[styles.logInput, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                placeholder="substance name (e.g., coffee, klonopin)"
                placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                value={newSubstanceName}
                onChangeText={setNewSubstanceName}
                autoFocus
              />
              <View style={styles.modalButtons}>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleAddSubstance} style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.bg }]}>Add</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => { setShowAddSubstance(false); setNewSubstanceName(''); }}
                  style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>Cancel</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          )}

{substances.length > 0 ? (
            <View style={styles.patternSection}>
              <Text style={[styles.patternSectionTitle, { color: colors.accent }]}>YOUR SUBSTANCES</Text>
              {substances.map(substance => {
                const interactionCount = allyLogs.filter(log => log.specific_name === substance.name).length;
                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    key={substance.id}
                    onPress={() => { setActiveSubstance(substance); setCurrentScreen('log-chemical'); }}
                    onLongPress={() => handleDeleteSubstance(substance.id)}
                    style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.patternItemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{substance.name}</Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim }]}>{interactionCount} interaction{interactionCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''} logged</Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim, fontSize: 11, marginTop: 4 }]}>(long press to delete)</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={[styles.emptyState, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.emptyText, { color: colors.dim }]}>Add a substance to begin tracking interactions.</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    );
  }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER: LOG-CHEMICAL
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (currentScreen === 'log-chemical' && activeSubstance) {
    const substanceLogs = allyLogs.filter(log => log.specific_name === activeSubstance.name);
    return (
      <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => { setActiveSubstance(null); setCurrentScreen('chemicals'); }} style={styles.backButton}>
            <Text style={[styles.backText, { color: colors.dim }]}>← back to library</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

<Text style={[styles.substanceTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{activeSubstance.name}</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.substanceSubtitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>{substanceLogs.length} interaction{substanceLogs.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} logged</Text>

{!editingTrinity && activeSubstance.notes && (
            <View style={[styles.trinityCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.trinityText, { color: colors.text }]}>{activeSubstance.notes}</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleStartEditTrinity} style={{ marginTop: 12, alignSelf: 'flex-end' }}>
                <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim, fontSize: 12 }]}>(tap to edit wisdom)</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          )}

{editingTrinity && (
            <View style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card, marginBottom: 24 }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginBottom: 8 }]}>Trinity Wisdom</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={[styles.logInput, styles.logInputMulti, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim, minHeight: 180 }]}
                placeholder="Invocation → Shadow → Integration"
                placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                value={trinityEditText}
                onChangeText={setTrinityEditText}
                multiline
                autoFocus
              />
              <View style={styles.modalButtons}>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSaveTrinity} style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.bg }]}>Save</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => { setEditingTrinity(false); setTrinityEditText(''); }}
                  style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>Cancel</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          )}

{!activeSubstance.notes && !editingTrinity && (
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleStartEditTrinity} style={[styles.addButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.dim, marginBottom: 24 }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.addButtonText, { color: colors.dim }]}>+ add trinity wisdom</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}

<TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setShowInteractionModal(true)} style={[styles.logButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
            <Text style={[styles.logButtonText, { color: colors.bg }]}>+ log interaction</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

{substanceLogs.length > 0 ? (
            <View style={styles.patternSection}>
              <Text style={[styles.patternSectionTitle, { color: colors.accent }]}>HISTORY</Text>
              {substanceLogs.map(log => (
                <View key={log.id} style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim, marginBottom: 8 }]}>
                    {new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })}
                  </Text>
                  {log.amount && <Text style={[styles.patternItemTitle, { color: colors.text, fontSize: 16 }]}>{log.amount} • {log.route}</Text>}
                  {log.state_before && <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginTop: 8 }]}>Why: {log.state_before}</Text>}

---

{log.state_after && <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginTop: 4 }]}>Effect: {log.state_after}</Text>}
                  <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => deleteAllyLog(log.id)}>
                    <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim, marginTop: 12, fontSize: 11 }]}>(tap to delete)</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={[styles.emptyState, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.emptyText, { color: colors.dim }]}>No interactions logged yet.</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </ScrollView>

{/* Interaction Modal */}
        <Modal visible={showInteractionModal} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={() => setShowInteractionModal(false)}>
          <View style={styles.shiftModalOverlay}>
            <View style={[styles.shiftModalContent, { backgroundColor: colors.card, width: '85%', maxHeight: '80%' }]}>
              <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
                <Text style={[styles.patternsTitle, { color: colors.text, fontSize: 22, marginBottom: 24 }]}>Log Interaction</Text>

<Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginBottom: 8 }]}>How did you take it?</Text>
                <View style={styles.tagsContainer}>
                  {(['oral', 'smoked', 'vaped', 'sublingual', 'nasal', 'topical', 'other'] as SubstanceRoute[]).map(route => (
                    <TouchableOpacity
                      key={route}
                      onPress={() => setModalRoute(route)}
                      style={[styles.tagChip, { backgroundColor: modalRoute === route ? colors.accent : colors.bg, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
                    >
                      <Text style={[styles.tagText, { color: modalRoute === route ? colors.bg : colors.text }]}>{route}</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  ))}
                </View>

<Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginTop: 16, marginBottom: 8 }]}>How much? (optional)</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.logInput, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  placeholder="e.g., 2mg, 1 cup, micro"
                  placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                  value={modalDosage}
                  onChangeText={setModalDosage}
                />

<Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginTop: 16, marginBottom: 8 }]}>Why this moment?</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.logInput, styles.logInputMulti, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  placeholder="tension, focus needed, celebration..."
                  placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                  value={modalWhy}
                  onChangeText={setModalWhy}
                  multiline
                />

<Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginTop: 16, marginBottom: 8 }]}>How do you feel?</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.logInput, styles.logInputMulti, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  placeholder="what shifted, what you notice..."
                  placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                  value={modalFeeling}
                  onChangeText={setModalFeeling}
                  multiline
                />

<View style={styles.modalButtons}>
                  <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleLogInteraction} style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                    <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.bg }]}>Save</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    onPress={() => { setShowInteractionModal(false); setModalRoute('oral'); setModalDosage(''); setModalWhy(''); setModalFeeling(''); }}
                    style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>Cancel</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              </ScrollView>
            </View>
          </View>
        </Modal>
      </View>
    );
  }

return null;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// STYLES
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { flex: 1 },
  scrollContent: { padding: 24, paddingTop: 60 },

  scrollWithFooter: { paddingBottom: 160 },

header: { flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 8 },
  containerTitle: { fontSize: 28, fontWeight: '400' },
  containerSubtitle: { fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 32, fontWeight: '300' },

// Bottom stacked buttons
  bottomStackButtons: {
    position: 'absolute',
    left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0,

    paddingBottom: Platform.select({ ios: 24, android: 16 }),

    borderTopWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    borderTopColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'
  },

    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center'
  },

// Navigation box buttons (reused style)
  navBoxButton: { paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingVertical: 10, borderRadius: 10, borderWidth: 1.5, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' },
  navBoxButtonText: { fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '500', letterSpacing: 0.3 },

// First pixel
  firstPixelContainer: { marginBottom: 32 },
  firstPixelPrompt: { fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 16, fontWeight: '300' },
  firstPixelCard: { padding: 24, borderRadius: 16, borderWidth: 2, marginBottom: 12 },
  showAllText: { fontSize: 14, textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 8 },

// Sections
  section: { marginBottom: 32 },
  sectionTitle: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '600', letterSpacing: 1, marginBottom: 12 },

// Items
  itemCard: { padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 8, borderWidth: 1 },
  itemTitle: { fontSize: 18, marginBottom: 4 },
  itemCue: { fontSize: 14, marginTop: 8, fontStyle: 'italic' },
  itemActions: { marginTop: 12 },
  actionText: { fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '500' },
  completionNote: { fontSize: 12, marginTop: 4 },
  longPressHint: { fontSize: 10, marginTop: 4, fontStyle: 'italic' },

// Add button (reused)
  addButton: { padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 1, alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 16 },
  addButtonText: { fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '400' },

// Modal
  modalOverlay: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', justifyContent: 'center', padding: 24 },
  modalContent: { borderRadius: 16, padding: 24 },
  modalTitle: { fontSize: 24, fontWeight: '400', marginBottom: 24 },

---

typeSelector: { flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, marginBottom: 16 },
  typeButton: { flex: 1, padding: 12, borderRadius: 8, borderWidth: 1, alignItems: 'center' },
  typeButtonText: { fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '500' },
  input: { padding: 12, borderRadius: 8, borderWidth: 1, marginBottom: 16, fontSize: 16 },
  modalActions: { flexDirection: 'row', gap: 12, marginTop: 8 },
  modalButton: { flex: 1, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, alignItems: 'center' },
  modalButtonText: { fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '500' },
  modalButtons: { flexDirection: 'row', gap: 12, marginTop: 16 },

// Detail screen
  backButton: { marginBottom: 24 },
  backText: { fontSize: 16 },
  detailTitle: { fontSize: 32, fontWeight: '400', marginBottom: 24 },
  cueBox: { padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16, borderLeftWidth: 4 },
  cueLabel: { fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 8 },
  cueText: { fontSize: 16 },
  microBox: { padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 32 },
  microLabel: { fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 8 },
  microText: { fontSize: 16, fontStyle: 'italic' },

// Outcome buttons
  outcomeButtons: { gap: 12 },
  outcomeButton: { padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, alignItems: 'center' },
  outcomeButtonText: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '500' },
  outcomeRow: { flexDirection: 'row', gap: 12 },
  outcomeButtonSmall: { flex: 1, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 1, alignItems: 'center' },
  outcomeButtonTextSmall: { fontSize: 14 },
  completedBox: { padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, alignItems: 'center' },
  completedText: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '500', marginBottom: 8 },
  completedDetail: { fontSize: 14 },

// Afterfeel screen
  outcomeTitle: { fontSize: 28, fontWeight: '400', marginBottom: 32 },
  afterfeelButtons: { gap: 12, marginBottom: 32 },
  afterfeelButton: { padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 1, alignItems: 'center' },
  afterfeelText: { fontSize: 18 },
  tagsPrompt: { fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 16 },
  tagsContainer: { flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8, marginBottom: 32 },
  tagChip: { paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingVertical: 8, borderRadius: 20, borderWidth: 1 },
  tagText: { fontSize: 14 },
  doneButton: { padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 16 },
  doneButtonText: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '500' },
  skipText: { fontSize: 14, textAlign: 'center' },

// Patterns screen
  patternsTitle: { fontSize: 28, fontWeight: '400', marginBottom: 8 },
  patternsSubtitle: { fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 32 },
  patternSection: { marginBottom: 32 },
  patternSectionTitle: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '600', letterSpacing: 1, marginBottom: 12 },
  patternCard: { padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 8 },
  patternItemTitle: { fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 4 },
  patternMetric: { fontSize: 14 },
  emptyState: { padding: 32, borderRadius: 12, alignItems: 'center' },
  emptyText: { fontSize: 16, textAlign: 'center' },

// Shift modal
  shiftModalOverlay: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' },
  shiftModalContent: { padding: 32, borderRadius: 16, marginHorizontal: 48, alignItems: 'center' },
```

  return 'evening';
};

            </View>
          )}
        </Animated.ScrollView>

{/* Shift modal (also here) */}
        <Modal visible={showShiftModal} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={() => setShowShiftModal(false)}>
          <View style={styles.shiftModalOverlay}>
            <View style={[styles.shiftModalContent, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.shiftModalText, { color: colors.text }]}>feel that shift?</Text>
              <View style={styles.shiftModalButtons}>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => handleShiftResponse(true)} style={[styles.shiftModalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.shiftModalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>yes</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => handleShiftResponse(false)}
                  style={[styles.shiftModalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent, borderWidth: 1 }]}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.shiftModalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>not yet</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleShiftSkipAlways}>
                <Text style={[styles.shiftModalSkip, { color: colors.dim }]}>skip always</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </Modal>
      </View>
    );
  }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER: OUTCOME
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (currentScreen === 'outcome') {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
          <Text style={[styles.outcomeTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>How did it feel?</Text>

<View style={styles.afterfeelButtons}>
            {(['lighter', 'same', 'spikier'] as Afterfeel[]).map(feel => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={feel}
                onPress={() => setTempAfterfeel(feel)}
                style={[styles.afterfeelButton, { backgroundColor: tempAfterfeel === feel ? colors.accent : colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.afterfeelText, { color: colors.text }]}>{feel}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>

<Text style={[styles.tagsPrompt, { color: colors.dim }]}>What helped? (pick up to 2, or skip)</Text>

<View style={styles.tagsContainer}>
            {(['water', 'light', 'movement', 'sound', 'novelty', 'social'] as ResonanceTag[]).map(tag => (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={tag}
                onPress={() => {
                  if (tempTags.includes(tag)) setTempTags(tempTags.filter(t => t !== tag));
                  else if (tempTags.length < 2) setTempTags([...tempTags, tag]);
                }}
                style={[styles.tagChip, { backgroundColor: tempTags.includes(tag) ? colors.accent : colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.tagText, { color: colors.text }]}>{tag}</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ))}
          </View>

<TouchableOpacity
            onPress={() => { if (tempAfterfeel) handleAfterfeelSelect(tempAfterfeel, tempTags); }}
            style={[styles.doneButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent, opacity: tempAfterfeel ? 1 : 0.5 }]}
            disabled={!tempAfterfeel}
          >
            <Text style={[styles.doneButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>done</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

<TouchableOpacity onPress={() => handleAfterfeelSelect('same', [])}>
            <Text style={[styles.skipText, { color: colors.dim }]}>skip</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    );
  }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER: PATTERNS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (currentScreen === 'patterns') {
    const { resonating, notSticking } = getPatternInsights();
    return (
      <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setCurrentScreen('containers')} style={styles.backButton}>
            <Text style={[styles.backText, { color: colors.dim }]}>← back</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

<Text style={[styles.patternsTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>This Week's Patterns</Text>

---

<Text style={[styles.patternsSubtitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>no judgment, just data</Text>

<View style={styles.patternSection}>
            <Text style={[styles.patternSectionTitle, { color: colors.accent }]}>OVERALL PATTERNS</Text>

{!showPatternInput ? (
              <TouchableOpacity
                onPress={() => setShowPatternInput(true)}
                style={[styles.addButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.addButtonText, { color: colors.accent }]}>+ notice a pattern</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ) : (
              <View style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.logInput, styles.logInputMulti, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  placeholder="what are you noticing? energy, timing, triggers, rhythms..."
                  placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                  value={newPatternNote}
                  onChangeText={setNewPatternNote}
                  multiline
                  autoFocus
                />
                <View style={styles.modalButtons}>
                  <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSavePatternNote} style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                    <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.bg }]}>Save</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    onPress={() => { setShowPatternInput(false); setNewPatternNote(''); }}
                    style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>Cancel</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              </View>
            )}

{patternNotes.map(note => (
              <View key={note.id} style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
                <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim, marginBottom: 8 }]}>
                  {new Date(note.date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}
                </Text>
                <Text style={[styles.patternItemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{note.note}</Text>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => deletePatternNote(note.id)}>
                  <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim, marginTop: 8 }]}>(tap to delete)</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>

{resonating.length > 0 && (
            <View style={styles.patternSection}>
              <Text style={[styles.patternSectionTitle, { color: colors.accent }]}>WHAT'S WORKING</Text>
              {resonating.map(({ item, count }) => (
                <View key={item.id} style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.patternItemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{item.title}</Text>
                  <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim }]}>{count}/7 days</Text>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          )}

{notSticking.length > 0 && (
            <View style={styles.patternSection}>
              <Text style={[styles.patternSectionTitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>NOT STICKING</Text>
              {notSticking.map(({ item, count }) => (
                <View key={item.id} style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.patternItemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{item.title}</Text>
                  <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim }]}>{count}/7 days — maybe too much friction?</Text>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          )}

{resonating.length === 0 && notSticking.length === 0 && (
            <View style={[styles.emptyState, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.emptyText, { color: colors.dim }]}>Not enough data yet. Check back after a few days of tracking.</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    );
  }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER: CHEMICALS
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (currentScreen === 'chemicals') {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setCurrentScreen('containers')} style={styles.backButton}>
            <Text style={[styles.backText, { color: colors.dim }]}>← back</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

<Text style={[styles.patternsTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>Chemical Relationships</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.patternsSubtitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>your living pharmacopeia</Text>

{!showAddSubstance ? (
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setShowAddSubstance(true)} style={[styles.addButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.addButtonText, { color: colors.accent }]}>+ add substance</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          ) : (
            <View style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card, marginBottom: 24 }]}>
              <TextInput
                style={[styles.logInput, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                placeholder="substance name (e.g., coffee, klonopin)"
                placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                value={newSubstanceName}
                onChangeText={setNewSubstanceName}
                autoFocus
              />
              <View style={styles.modalButtons}>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleAddSubstance} style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.bg }]}>Add</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => { setShowAddSubstance(false); setNewSubstanceName(''); }}
                  style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>Cancel</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          )}

{substances.length > 0 ? (
            <View style={styles.patternSection}>
              <Text style={[styles.patternSectionTitle, { color: colors.accent }]}>YOUR SUBSTANCES</Text>
              {substances.map(substance => {
                const interactionCount = allyLogs.filter(log => log.specific_name === substance.name).length;
                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    key={substance.id}
                    onPress={() => { setActiveSubstance(substance); setCurrentScreen('log-chemical'); }}
                    onLongPress={() => handleDeleteSubstance(substance.id)}
                    style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.patternItemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{substance.name}</Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim }]}>{interactionCount} interaction{interactionCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''} logged</Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim, fontSize: 11, marginTop: 4 }]}>(long press to delete)</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={[styles.emptyState, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.emptyText, { color: colors.dim }]}>Add a substance to begin tracking interactions.</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    );
  }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // RENDER: LOG-CHEMICAL
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (currentScreen === 'log-chemical' && activeSubstance) {
    const substanceLogs = allyLogs.filter(log => log.specific_name === activeSubstance.name);
    return (
      <View style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}>
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => { setActiveSubstance(null); setCurrentScreen('chemicals'); }} style={styles.backButton}>
            <Text style={[styles.backText, { color: colors.dim }]}>← back to library</Text>

---

</TouchableOpacity>

<Text style={[styles.substanceTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>{activeSubstance.name}</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.substanceSubtitle, { color: colors.dim }]}>{substanceLogs.length} interaction{substanceLogs.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} logged</Text>

{!editingTrinity && activeSubstance.notes && (
            <View style={[styles.trinityCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.trinityText, { color: colors.text }]}>{activeSubstance.notes}</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleStartEditTrinity} style={{ marginTop: 12, alignSelf: 'flex-end' }}>
                <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim, fontSize: 12 }]}>(tap to edit wisdom)</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          )}

{editingTrinity && (
            <View style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card, marginBottom: 24 }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginBottom: 8 }]}>Trinity Wisdom</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={[styles.logInput, styles.logInputMulti, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim, minHeight: 180 }]}
                placeholder="Invocation → Shadow → Integration"
                placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                value={trinityEditText}
                onChangeText={setTrinityEditText}
                multiline
                autoFocus
              />
              <View style={styles.modalButtons}>
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleSaveTrinity} style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.bg }]}>Save</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  onPress={() => { setEditingTrinity(false); setTrinityEditText(''); }}
                  style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>Cancel</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          )}

{!activeSubstance.notes && !editingTrinity && (
            <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleStartEditTrinity} style={[styles.addButton, { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.dim, marginBottom: 24 }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.addButtonText, { color: colors.dim }]}>+ add trinity wisdom</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}

<TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setShowInteractionModal(true)} style={[styles.logButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
            <Text style={[styles.logButtonText, { color: colors.bg }]}>+ log interaction</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

{substanceLogs.length > 0 ? (
            <View style={styles.patternSection}>
              <Text style={[styles.patternSectionTitle, { color: colors.accent }]}>HISTORY</Text>
              {substanceLogs.map(log => (
                <View key={log.id} style={[styles.patternCard, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
                  <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim, marginBottom: 8 }]}>
                    {new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })}
                  </Text>
                  {log.amount && <Text style={[styles.patternItemTitle, { color: colors.text, fontSize: 16 }]}>{log.amount} • {log.route}</Text>}
                  {log.state_before && <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginTop: 8 }]}>Why: {log.state_before}</Text>}
                  {log.state_after && <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginTop: 4 }]}>Effect: {log.state_after}</Text>}
                  <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => deleteAllyLog(log.id)}>
                    <Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.dim, marginTop: 12, fontSize: 11 }]}>(tap to delete)</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={[styles.emptyState, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>
              <Text style={[styles.emptyText, { color: colors.dim }]}>No interactions logged yet.</Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </ScrollView>

{/* Interaction Modal */}
        <Modal visible={showInteractionModal} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={() => setShowInteractionModal(false)}>
          <View style={styles.shiftModalOverlay}>
            <View style={[styles.shiftModalContent, { backgroundColor: colors.card, width: '85%', maxHeight: '80%' }]}>
              <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
                <Text style={[styles.patternsTitle, { color: colors.text, fontSize: 22, marginBottom: 24 }]}>Log Interaction</Text>

<Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginBottom: 8 }]}>How did you take it?</Text>
                <View style={styles.tagsContainer}>
                  {(['oral', 'smoked', 'vaped', 'sublingual', 'nasal', 'topical', 'other'] as SubstanceRoute[]).map(route => (
                    <TouchableOpacity
                      key={route}
                      onPress={() => setModalRoute(route)}
                      style={[styles.tagChip, { backgroundColor: modalRoute === route ? colors.accent : colors.bg, borderColor: colors.accent }]}
                    >
                      <Text style={[styles.tagText, { color: modalRoute === route ? colors.bg : colors.text }]}>{route}</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  ))}
                </View>

<Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginTop: 16, marginBottom: 8 }]}>How much? (optional)</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.logInput, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  placeholder="e.g., 2mg, 1 cup, micro"
                  placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                  value={modalDosage}
                  onChangeText={setModalDosage}
                />

<Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginTop: 16, marginBottom: 8 }]}>Why this moment?</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.logInput, styles.logInputMulti, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  placeholder="tension, focus needed, celebration..."
                  placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                  value={modalWhy}
                  onChangeText={setModalWhy}
                  multiline
                />

<Text style={[styles.patternMetric, { color: colors.text, marginTop: 16, marginBottom: 8 }]}>How do you feel?</Text>
                <TextInput
                  style={[styles.logInput, styles.logInputMulti, { color: colors.text, backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  placeholder="what shifted, what you notice..."
                  placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
                  value={modalFeeling}
                  onChangeText={setModalFeeling}
                  multiline
                />

<View style={styles.modalButtons}>
                  <TouchableOpacity onPress={handleLogInteraction} style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}>
                    <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.bg }]}>Save</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    onPress={() => { setShowInteractionModal(false); setModalRoute('oral'); setModalDosage(''); setModalWhy(''); setModalFeeling(''); }}
                    style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.bg, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: colors.dim }]}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.modalButtonText, { color: colors.text }]}>Cancel</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              </ScrollView>
            </View>
          </View>
        </Modal>
      </View>
    );
  }

return null;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// STYLES
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const styles = StyleSheet.create({

// First pixel
  firstPixelContainer: { marginBottom: 32 },
  firstPixelPrompt: { fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 16, fontWeight: '300' },
  firstPixelCard: { padding: 24, borderRadius: 16, borderWidth: 2, marginBottom: 12 },
  showAllText: { fontSize: 14, textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 8 },

// Sections
  section: { marginBottom: 32 },
  sectionTitle: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '600', letterSpacing: 1, marginBottom: 12 },

// Items
  itemCard: { padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 8, borderWidth: 1 },
  itemTitle: { fontSize: 18, marginBottom: 4 },
  itemCue: { fontSize: 14, marginTop: 8, fontStyle: 'italic' },
  itemActions: { marginTop: 12 },
  actionText: { fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '500' },
  completionNote: { fontSize: 12, marginTop: 4 },
  longPressHint: { fontSize: 10, marginTop: 4, fontStyle: 'italic' },

// Add button (reused)
  addButton: { padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 1, alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 16 },

// Modal
  modalOverlay: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', justifyContent: 'center', padding: 24 },

  typeButton: { flex: 1, padding: 12, borderRadius: 8, borderWidth: 1, alignItems: 'center' },
  typeButtonText: { fontSize: 14, fontWeight: '500' },
  input: { padding: 12, borderRadius: 8, borderWidth: 1, marginBottom: 16, fontSize: 16 },
  modalActions: { flexDirection: 'row', gap: 12, marginTop: 8 },
  modalButton: { flex: 1, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, alignItems: 'center' },
  modalButtonText: { fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '500' },
  modalButtons: { flexDirection: 'row', gap: 12, marginTop: 16 },

// Detail screen
  backButton: { marginBottom: 24 },
  backText: { fontSize: 16 },
  detailTitle: { fontSize: 32, fontWeight: '400', marginBottom: 24 },
  cueBox: { padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 16, borderLeftWidth: 4 },
  cueLabel: { fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 8 },
  cueText: { fontSize: 16 },
  microBox: { padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 32 },
  microLabel: { fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 8 },
  microText: { fontSize: 16, fontStyle: 'italic' },

// Outcome buttons
  outcomeButtons: { gap: 12 },
  outcomeButton: { padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, alignItems: 'center' },
  outcomeButtonText: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '500' },
  outcomeRow: { flexDirection: 'row', gap: 12 },
  outcomeButtonSmall: { flex: 1, padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 1, alignItems: 'center' },
  outcomeButtonTextSmall: { fontSize: 14 },
  completedBox: { padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, alignItems: 'center' },
  completedText: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '500', marginBottom: 8 },
  completedDetail: { fontSize: 14 },

// Afterfeel screen
  outcomeTitle: { fontSize: 28, fontWeight: '400', marginBottom: 32 },
  afterfeelButtons: { gap: 12, marginBottom: 32 },
  afterfeelButton: { padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 1, alignItems: 'center' },
  afterfeelText: { fontSize: 18 },
  tagsPrompt: { fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 16 },
  tagsContainer: { flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8, marginBottom: 32 },
  tagChip: { paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingVertical: 8, borderRadius: 20, borderWidth: 1 },
  tagText: { fontSize: 14 },
  doneButton: { padding: 20, borderRadius: 12, alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 16 },
  doneButtonText: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '500' },
  skipText: { fontSize: 14, textAlign: 'center' },

// Patterns screen
  patternsTitle: { fontSize: 28, fontWeight: '400', marginBottom: 8 },
  patternsSubtitle: { fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 32 },
  patternSection: { marginBottom: 32 },
  patternSectionTitle: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: '600', letterSpacing: 1, marginBottom: 12 },

---

patternCard: { padding: 16, borderRadius: 12, marginBottom: 8 },
  patternItemTitle: { fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 4 },
  patternMetric: { fontSize: 14 },
  emptyState: { padding: 32, borderRadius: 12, alignItems: 'center' },
  emptyText: { fontSize: 16, textAlign: 'center' },

// Shift modal
  shiftModalOverlay: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' },

# Paste-in code (1 helper + 1 tiny UI hook)

### 1) Replace your current `getPatternInsights` with this
```ts
// Drop-in: replaces getPatternInsights()
const getPatternInsights = () => {
  const today = new Date();
  const startOfWeek = new Date(today);
  startOfWeek.setDate(today.getDate() - 6); // last 7 days window

const inWindow = (d: string) => new Date(d) >= new Date(startOfWeek.toDateString());

const weekCompletions = completions.filter(c => inWindow(c.date));
  const dids = weekCompletions.filter(c => c.outcome === 'did');

// 1) Micro-streak: consecutive days (ending today) with ≥1 'did'
  const dayKey = (d: Date) => d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
  let streak = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    const d = new Date(); d.setDate(today.getDate()-i);
    const k = dayKey(d);
    const anyDid = completions.some(c => c.date === k && c.outcome === 'did');
    if (anyDid) streak++; else break;
  }

// 2) Completion rate + diversity (how many distinct items had 'did')
  const totalActions = weekCompletions.length;
  const didCount = dids.length;
  const didItemSet = new Set(dids.map(d => d.item_id));
  const diversity = didItemSet.size;
  const completionRate = totalActions ? Math.round((didCount / totalActions) * 100) : 0;

// 3) Tag resonance counts
  const tagCounts: Record<ResonanceTag, number> = {
    water:0, light:0, movement:0, sound:0, novelty:0, social:0
  };
  dids.forEach(d => (d.resonance_tags||[]).forEach(t => tagCounts[t]++));

// 4) Ally balance for the week (from allyLogs)
  const weekLogs = allyLogs.filter(l => inWindow(l.day_key));
  const allyCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  weekLogs.forEach(l => {
    const key = (l.specific_name || l.ally || 'ally').toLowerCase();
    allyCounts[key] = (allyCounts[key] || 0) + 1;
  });

// 5) Coherence score (simple, tweakable)
  // weights: dids (3), diversity (2 each up to 5), completionRate (direct), streak bonus (2 per day up to 10)
  const diversityCap = Math.min(diversity, 5);
  const streakBonus = Math.min(streak, 5) * 2;
  let score = Math.round(
    Math.min(100,
      (didCount * 3) +            // showing up
      (diversityCap * 2) +        // variety
      (completionRate * 0.5) +    // consistency
      streakBonus                 // gentle streak boost
    )
  );

return {
    streak,
    completionRate,
    diversity,
    tagCounts,
    allyCounts,
    didCount,
    totalActions,
    score,
    weekCompletions
  };
};
```

### 1) Add a type (put this with your other interfaces)
```ts
interface DayNote {
  id: string;
  container: ContainerId;   // morning/afternoon/evening/late
  date: string;             // YYYY-MM-DD
  text: string;
  timestamp: string;        // full ISO
}
```

### 2) State + storage (place near your other storage-backed states)
```ts
// Daily notes
const [dayNotes, setDayNotes] = useState<DayNote[]>([]);
const [noteDraft, setNoteDraft] = useState('');          // for editor
const [noteModalVisible, setNoteModalVisible] = useState(false);
const [noteModalContainer, setNoteModalContainer] = useState<ContainerId>('morning');

// load notes
useEffect(() => {
  (async () => {
    try {
      const saved = await AsyncStorage.getItem('dayNotes');
      if (saved) setDayNotes(JSON.parse(saved));
    } catch {}
  })();
}, []);

// save notes
useEffect(() => {
  AsyncStorage.setItem('dayNotes', JSON.stringify(dayNotes));
}, [dayNotes]);
```

### 3) Helpers (drop under your other helpers)
```ts
const todayKey = () => new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

const getTodayNoteFor = (containerId: ContainerId): DayNote | undefined =>
  dayNotes.find(n => n.container === containerId && n.date === todayKey());

const openNoteEditor = (containerId: ContainerId) => {
  const existing = getTodayNoteFor(containerId);
  setNoteDraft(existing?.text || '');
  setNoteModalContainer(containerId);
  setNoteModalVisible(true);
};

const saveNote = () => {
  const existing = getTodayNoteFor(noteModalContainer);
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

if (existing) {
    setDayNotes(dayNotes.map(n =>
      n.id === existing.id ? { ...n, text: noteDraft, timestamp: nowIso } : n
    ));
  } else {
    const newNote: DayNote = {
      id: `note-${Date.now()}`,
      container: noteModalContainer,
      date: todayKey(),
      text: noteDraft.trim(),
      timestamp: nowIso
    };
    setDayNotes([newNote, ...dayNotes]);
  }

setNoteModalVisible(false);
  setNoteDraft('');
};
```

### 4) UI block on the **containers** screen  
Insert this **right under** the time + subtitle (before the First Pixel card).

---

```tsx

{(() => {
    const note = getTodayNoteFor(currentContainer);
    return (
      <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={() => openNoteEditor(currentContainer)}
        style={[
          styles.itemCard,
          { backgroundColor: colors.card, borderColor: colors.accent }
        ]}
      >
        <Text style={[styles.itemTitle, { color: colors.text }]}>
          {note?.text?.trim() ? note.text : 'tap to add a note for this time of day'}
        </Text>
        {note?.timestamp && (
          <Text style={[styles.itemCue, { color: colors.dim, marginTop: 6 }]}>
            last edited {new Date(note.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })}
          </Text>
        )}
      </TouchableOpacity>
    );
  })()}
</View>
```

### 5) Modal editor (add near your other modals at the bottom of the component)
```tsx

<Modal visible={noteModalVisible} transparent animationType="slide">
  <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
    <View style={[styles.modalContent, { backgroundColor: colors.card }]}>

      </Text>

        style={[
          styles.input,
          {
            backgroundColor: colors.bg,
            color: colors.text,
            borderColor: colors.accent,
            minHeight: 120,
            textAlignVertical: 'top',

          }
        ]}
        placeholder="what feels relevant for this window — context, intentions, threads to follow…"
        placeholderTextColor={colors.dim}
        multiline
        value={noteDraft}

      />

<View style={styles.modalActions}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={() => {
            setNoteModalVisible(false);
            setNoteDraft('');
          }}
          style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.bg }]}
        >

        </TouchableOpacity>

<TouchableOpacity
          onPress={saveNote}
          style={[styles.modalButton, { backgroundColor: colors.accent }]}
        >

        </TouchableOpacity>

</Modal>
```

type SubstanceRoute = 'oral' | 'smoked' | 'vaped' | 'sublingual' | 'nasal' | 'topical' | 'other';
type SubstanceIntention = 'relief' | 'focus' | 'connection' | 'exploration' | 'rest' | 'celebration' | 'medicine';
type SubstanceRelation = 'lighter' | 'same' | 'spikier' | 'teachings' | 'warnings';

interface AllyArchetype {
  name: string;
  face: string;
  function: string;
  shadow: string;
  invocation: string;
}

interface SubstanceLog {
  id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  day_key: string;
  ally: SubstanceAlly;
  specific_name?: string;
  amount?: string;
  route?: SubstanceRoute;
  intention?: SubstanceIntention;

// Pre-contact
  state_before?: string;
  craving_intensity?: number;

// Post-contact
  felt_effect?: SubstanceRelation;
  state_after?: string;
  gratitude?: string;
  caution?: string;

// Context
  with_others?: boolean;
  setting?: string;
}

interface ContainerItem {
  id: string;
  type: ItemType;
  title: string;
  body_cue?: string;
  micro_version?: string;
  container: ContainerId;

// If appointment
  time?: string;
  date?: string;
  warmup_enabled?: boolean;
  warmup_task?: string;
  buffer_minutes?: number;
}

interface Completion {
  item_id: string;
  container: ContainerId;
  date: string;
  outcome: Outcome;
  afterfeel?: Afterfeel;
  resonance_tags?: ResonanceTag[];
  miss_reason?: MissReason;
}

interface TimeContainer {
  id: ContainerId;
  label: string;
  window: [number, number];
  pressure_mode: PressureMode;
}

interface ThemeColors {
  bg: string;
  card: string;
  accent: string;
  text: string;
  dim: string;
}

// UTILITY
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const getCurrentContainer = (): ContainerId => {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour >= 0 && hour < 6) return 'late';
  if (hour >= 6 && hour < 12) return 'morning';
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 18) return 'afternoon';
  return 'evening';
};

export default function PDATaskAppV2() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('forest');
  const colors = THEMES[theme];

const [currentScreen, setCurrentScreen] = useState<

  >('containers');

const [containers] = useState<TimeContainer[]>([
    { id: 'late', label: 'Late Night / Early Morning', window: [0, 6], pressure_mode: 'normal' },

    { id: 'evening', label: 'Evening', window: [18, 24], pressure_mode: 'normal' }
  ]);

const [items, setItems] = useState<ContainerItem[]>(() => {
    const allItems: ContainerItem[] = [];
    let idCounter = 0;
    Object.entries(DEFAULT_GROUNDING).forEach(([containerId, tasks]) => {

        allItems.push({ ...task, id: `item-${idCounter++}`, container: containerId as ContainerId });
      });

    return allItems;

const [completions, setCompletions] = useState<Completion[]>([]);

  const getCompletionPhrase = (): string => {
    let newIndex;
    do newIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * completionPhrases.length);
    while (newIndex === lastPhraseIndex && completionPhrases.length > 1);
    setLastPhraseIndex(newIndex);
    return completionPhrases[newIndex];
  };

const [currentContainer, setCurrentContainer] = useState<ContainerId>(getCurrentContainer());
  const [activeItem, setActiveItem] = useState<ContainerItem | null>(null);
  const [showFirstPixel, setShowFirstPixel] = useState(true);
  const [selectedOutcome, setSelectedOutcome] = useState<Outcome | null>(null);
  const [showShiftModal, setShowShiftModal] = useState(false);
  const [shiftYesCount, setShiftYesCount] = useState(0);
  const [completionPhrase, setCompletionPhrase] = useState('');

const [tempAfterfeel, setTempAfterfeel] = useState<Afterfeel | null>(null);

---

const [tempTags, setTempTags] = useState<ResonanceTag[]>([]);

// Ally logs

  const [newSubstanceName, setNewSubstanceName] = useState('');
  interface SubstanceEntry { id: string; name: string; notes?: string; created: string; }
  const [substances, setSubstances] = useState<SubstanceEntry[]>([]);
  const [activeSubstance, setActiveSubstance] = useState<SubstanceEntry | null>(null);

// Interaction modal
  const [showInteractionModal, setShowInteractionModal] = useState(false);
  const [modalRoute, setModalRoute] = useState<SubstanceRoute>('oral');

  const [modalWhy, setModalWhy] = useState('');
  const [modalFeeling, setModalFeeling] = useState('');

// Trinity editor
  const [editingTrinity, setEditingTrinity] = useState(false);
  const [trinityEditText, setTrinityEditText] = useState('');

// Add item modal
  const [addModalVisible, setAddModalVisible] = useState(false);

  const [newItemType, setNewItemType] = useState<'custom' | 'appointment'>('custom');
  const [newItemTime, setNewItemTime] = useState('');

// Pattern notes
  interface PatternNote { id: string; date: string; note: string; timestamp: string; }

// Animations
  const [fadeAnim] = useState(new Animated.Value(1));

// ── Persistence

  useEffect(() => { AsyncStorage.setItem('allyLogs', JSON.stringify(allyLogs)); }, [allyLogs]);

useEffect(() => { (async () => { try { const s = await AsyncStorage.getItem('substances'); if (s) setSubstances(JSON.parse(s)); } catch {} })(); }, []);

useEffect(() => { (async () => { try { const s = await AsyncStorage.getItem('patternNotes'); if (s) setPatternNotes(JSON.parse(s)); } catch {} })(); }, []);

// ── Trinity migration once
  useEffect(() => {
    const migrate = async () => {

      if (migrated) return;
      if (substances.length === 0 || !substances.some(s => !s.notes)) return;

const getTrinityWisdom = (name: string): string | undefined => {
        const lower = name.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.match(/coffee|caffeine|adderall|ritalin|vyvanse|stimulant|architect/))

Invocation: To build light into structure; to bring form without forgetting feeling.

Shadow: The mind's hunger for order that starves the body of rest.

Integration: Step away from the blueprint. Stretch. Let motion redraw the lines your mind designed.`;

setSubstances(updated);

    ]).start();

// Helpers
  const getContainerItems = (id: ContainerId) => items.filter(it => it.container === id);
  const getItemCompletion = (id: string) => {

const handleItemTap = (item: ContainerItem) => {

const handleOutcomeSelect = (outcome: Outcome) => {

if (outcome === 'did') {

        setCurrentScreen('containers');

    }

const handleShiftResponse = (felt: boolean) => {

    setShowShiftModal(false);

const handleShiftSkipAlways = () => {

// Substances
  const handleAddSubstance = () => {
    if (!newSubstanceName.trim()) return;
    const name = newSubstanceName.trim();

const wisdom = (() => {

Shadow: The hush that hides the song; the comfort that becomes forgetting.

Shadow: The drift that mistakes insight for arrival; the fog that calls itself peace.

      if (lower.match(/opioid|opiate|oxy|hydrocodone|morphine|fentanyl|heroin|kratom/)) return `⚫ Entropy's Embrace

Invocation: To rest without disappearing; to feel the mercy inside stillness.

Invocation: To spark curiosity without feeding compulsion.

Shadow: The tightening coil of control, mistaking precision for peace.

Invocation: To root awareness in the body that carries it.

Shadow: Forgetting simplicity in the pursuit of optimization.

Integration: Eat slowly. Thank the mineral world. Feel the floor hold you up.`;
